Add comorbidity indicators and scores (experimental)

Source: R/comorbidity.R
nis_comorbidity.Rd

Add Elixhauser or Charlson comorbidity flags and scores.

Usage

nis_comorbidity(
  .data,
  method = "elixhauser_ahrq_icd10",
  prefix = "cmrb_",
  count_distinct = FALSE,
  exclude_conditions = character()
)

Arguments

.data

A data frame, a tbl_svy from nis_design(), or a lazy DuckDB query. Lazy input requires non-missing, unique KEY_NIS, or unique pairs of YEAR and KEY_NIS when YEAR is present. Keep YEAR when pooling years.

method

Comorbidity definition. The default "elixhauser_ahrq_icd10" uses the medicalcoder ICD-10-CM union. "elixhauser_ahrq2022" through "elixhauser_ahrq2027" select a specific release. Use "charlson_quan2005" for Quan coding with original Charlson weights, "charlson_quan2011" for the same coding with Quan 2011 weights, and "charlson_deyo1992" for Deyo ICD-9-CM coding with original weights. "elixhauser_quan2005" uses Quan ICD-9-CM or ICD-10 coding and legacy AHRQ weights. "elixhauser_ahrq_web" and "elixhauser_elixhauser1998" replicate medicalcoder's legacy ICD-9 code-based algorithms. All methods except "elixhauser_ahrq2027" require the medicalcoder package.

prefix

Prefix for the added columns. Choose a prefix that does not collide with an existing name.

count_distinct

Set to TRUE to add the integer count <prefix>n_distinct. Each condition represented by any true flag counts once, using nis_comorbidity_condition_map(). A discharge with usable codes and no included conditions receives zero. A discharge without usable codes receives NA.

exclude_conditions

Character vector of unprefixed condition IDs to omit from the distinct count. Requires count_distinct = TRUE when nonempty. Exclusions affect only the distinct count.

Value

.data with logical condition flags and <prefix>any, the integer count <prefix>n, and either <prefix>mortality_index and <prefix>readmission_index (Elixhauser) or <prefix>cci (Charlson). Charlson scores are based on diagnoses and any mapped procedures without an age adjustment.

Coding and present on admission

Keep the applicable diagnosis slots and use character codes to retain ICD-9 leading zeros. Scoring excludes the principal diagnosis. Deyo can also use mapped ICD-9 procedure codes. A discharge with usable codes and no matches receives zero scores. A discharge without usable codes receives missing scores.

The NIS has no diagnosis-level present-on-admission (POA) fields. When a matching field is absent, the POA-aware methods assume that diagnosis was present on admission. AHRQ Refined Elixhauser leaves the POA-dependent measures unset when POA is unavailable.

Score before nis_design() to keep the work in DuckDB, or retain the diagnosis and available POA columns in an existing design.

See also

Derive outcomes, comorbidities, and costs.

Other outcomes and costs: nis_comorbidity_condition_map(), nis_cost(), nis_cost_provenance(), nis_outcomes()

Examples

nis <- nis_open(nis_example(2020))
nis_comorbidity(nis, method = "elixhauser_ahrq2027") |>
  dplyr::count(cmrb_mortality_index) |>
  dplyr::collect()
#> Warning: No matching POA column for some diagnosis slots. Assuming present on admission.
#> ℹ POA-dependent scores may include conditions acquired in hospital.
#> # A tibble: 2 × 2
#>   cmrb_mortality_index     n
#>                  <int> <dbl>
#> 1                   14    23
#> 2                    0    73
